title: The resume as the canvas draws it
description: GET /api/v1/documents/resume answers with this. The page lays the blocks out on A4 sheets in the order the typeset resume prints them (src/resume_form.js); every piece of text is a sentence with its evidence, so a click shows where it came from and a sentence without evidence stops the export.

draft.description: The draft on the canvas: when it was written, whether it is this edition's own or the general edition's, whether the facts changed since, and its counts.

photo.description: The resume's photo (GET /api/v1/photo), when the setting puts it on the resume; the detailed form only.

missing.description: What stops a resume from being made (name_missing, email_missing, no_roles).

sid.description: A sentence id: its path in the profile, then .sN for the sentence of a paragraph.

rows.description: Career rows also carry name, place, department and role (the printed table's own columns); career and education rows carry logo_id (the tile's name) and logo (its address), education rows sub, majorSub and note.

key.description: A section's part (overview, career, edu, comp, ...); a figure's name: timeline or stack.

src.description: A figure's address: GET /api/v1/jobs/{job}/figures/{lang}/{name}.png, drawn from the edition's profile as the PDF prints it.

w.description: A figure's width in pixels, so the page keeps its room before it loads.

logo.description: A role band's logo tile address (logo_id names the tile).

note.description: A section heading's grey words after its title, as printed: the career summary's total, "(총경력 7년 2개월)".

place.description: A role band's place, grey before its dates; career rows carry sub, the grey line under the company's name (place, then the role's note).

tenure.description: A role band's or a career row's time there, as the loader writes it ("1년", "2 yrs 3 mos").

sub.description: A role band's underlined line (the role's own, else department / title).

desc.description: A role band's grey line about the company.

badge.description: A role band's small mark beside the name (co-founder and the like).

groups.description: A list's printed parts in order: {caption, items: [{sid}], lines: [{sid, main, org, date}], table: {head, rows: [[{t, bold, accent}]], widths (twips), align} or null, note}. items holds every sentence of them too.

paras.description: About me (per item) and the motivation: the sentence ids of each printed paragraph.

title_long.description: A role band's long title (the role's titleLong, a career block's full one): the English one-column form prints it beside the company.

label.description: The service record's words (its label, else the ledger's chart words). Only the table form prints the service block.

period.description: A role band's or the service record's dates as printed (the service record's as written, joined with " ~ ").

state.description: ok: as the evidence says; edited: changed by the person and still within the evidence; unsupported: holds a number, tool or name the evidence does not; typed: the person's own words.

locked.description: Edit and Regenerate leave it alone, and a new draft keeps its words.

drafted.description: The agent wrote it from the evidence it cites (apps/api/drafts.py).

kind.description: The fact kind it rests on (project, role, card, ...).
